title: Unitree Go2 quadruped (go2.xml + go2_mjx.xml's position actuators), route contact variant solref 0.00125 s (Alloy's route step only)
world: floor z = 0; box obstacle 0.3 x 0.3 x 0.1 m at x = 1 m
changes: visual-only geoms and their meshes, materials and textures dropped

source keyframes dropped; keyframe 'init' = start state (robot start pose, ctrl = its joint targets, objects at rest), both clipped into the joint ranges; free-floating robots lifted so the deepest floor contact just touches
collision hulls above 64 vertices split into convex pieces within 0.2 mm (hull_split.json)

robot self-pairs overlapping > 0.5 mm at the start pose, or at qpos0 (where alloy.build starts a robot), excluded: H1-2's wrist yaw | thumb proximal, each hand; the Franka arms' link5 | hand (Panda) or link7 (FR3), whose hulls overlap 5.6-43 mm at qpos0 and 15-33 mm at joint6's lower limit; none elsewhere
options: jacobian sparse; <flag multiccd="disable"/> written out (Alloy's MJCF route, as for T12: Newton reads an absent flag as off, MuJoCo as on; explicit, both read off)

Go2 joint angles are measured from Menagerie's stand: add thigh 0.9, calf -1.8 rad to get Menagerie's angles. Each thigh and calf body is turned by its stand angle and its joint range, ctrl range and the 'init' keyframe shifted by it, so qpos0 (where alloy.build starts a robot) is the stand, feet on the floor, held by ctrl 0; Menagerie's calf range [-2.72, -0.84] excludes 0. The robot and its motion are unchanged (alloy.tasks.emb_robots.zero_at_start)

Go2's four foot balls (FL, FR, RL, RR): solimp 0.015 1 0.022 -> MuJoCo's default 0.9 0.95 0.001 and solref 0.02 -> 0.005 s. Menagerie's values carry 1.5 % of the contact force at the surface and all of it only 22 mm deep, so the robot stood 13.7 mm inside a rigid floor; it now rests 0.17 mm deep. Shapes, friction, condim and priority unchanged (alloy.tasks.emb_robots.firm_feet)

route contact variant of emb_e8_go2: every geom's solref set to [0.00125, 1.0] (time constant = 2 x Alloy's route step 0.000625 s, MuJoCo's floor; damping ratio); a solimp softer than MuJoCo's default (dmin < 0.9; Go2's feet) set to the default, as in _stiff; friction, margins, stiffer solimp and everything else as the verdict scene

contact.valid: valid at Alloy's route step (0.000625 s) only: an engine at the sources' 2 ms step clamps the time constant to 4 ms (MuJoCo's 2 dt floor)
